title: Grade 3 Unit 2 Source Set — slide 16 compass rose transcription
content: Slide 16, labeled compass rose: N at top; NE between N and E; E at right; SE between E and S; S at bottom; SW between S and W; W at left; NW between W and N. Opposite positions: N and S; E and W. Clockwise order: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW.
extractionMethod: Visual inspection of the original embedded labeled compass rose; positional transcription, not added lesson text. Direction answers are deductions from these positions.
